1.zh: 神的儿子，耶稣基督福音的起头。
1.en: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

1.zh: 正如先知以赛亚书上记着说： 看哪，我要差遣我的使者在你前面， 预备道路。
1.en: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:

1.zh: 在旷野有人声喊着说： 预备主的道， 修直他的路。
1.en: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”

1.zh: [照这话]，约翰来了，在旷野施洗，传悔改的洗礼，使罪得赦。
1.en: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

1.zh: 犹太全地和耶路撒冷的人都出去到约翰那里，承认他们的罪，在约旦河里受他的洗。
1.en: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

1.zh: 约翰穿骆驼毛[的衣服]，腰束皮带，吃的是蝗虫、野蜜。
1.en: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

1.zh: 他传道说：「有一位在我以后来的，能力比我更大，我就是弯腰给他解鞋带也是不配的。
1.en: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

1.zh: 我是用水给你们施洗，他却要用圣灵给你们施洗。」
1.en: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”

1.zh: 那时，耶稣从加利利的拿撒勒来，在约旦河里受了 约翰的洗。
1.en: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

1.zh: 他从水里一上来，就看见天裂开了，圣灵仿佛鸽子，降在他身上。
1.en: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

1.zh: 又有声音从天上来，[说]：「你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。」
1.en: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

1.zh: 圣灵就把耶稣催到旷野里去。
1.en: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

1.zh: 他在旷野四十天，受撒但的试探，并与野兽同在一处，且有天使来伺候他。
1.en: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

1.zh: 约翰下监以后，耶稣来到加利利，宣传　神的福音，
1.en: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

1.zh: 说：「日期满了，　神的国近了。你们当悔改，信福音！」
1.en: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

1.zh: 耶稣顺着加利利的海边走，看见西门和西门的兄弟安得烈在海里撒网；他们本是打鱼的。
1.en: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

1.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「来跟从我，我要叫你们得人如得鱼一样。」
1.en: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

1.zh: 他们就立刻舍了网，跟从了他。
1.en: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

1.zh: 耶稣稍往前走，又见西庇太的儿子雅各和雅各的兄弟约翰在船上补网。
1.en: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

1.zh: 耶稣随即招呼他们，他们就把父亲 西庇太和雇工人留在船上，跟从耶稣去了。
1.en: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

1.zh: 到了迦百农，耶稣就在安息日进了会堂教训人。
1.en: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

1.zh: 众人很希奇他的教训；因为他教训他们，正像有权柄的人，不像文士。
1.en: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

1.zh: 在会堂里，有一个人被污鬼附着。他喊叫说：
1.en: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

1.zh: 「拿撒勒人耶稣，我们与你有什么相干？你来灭我们吗？我知道你是谁，乃是　神的圣者。」
1.en: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

1.zh: 耶稣责备他说：「不要作声！从这人身上出来吧。」
1.en: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

1.zh: 污鬼叫那人抽了一阵风，大声喊叫，就出来了。
1.en: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

1.zh: 众人都惊讶，以致彼此对问说：「这是什么事？是个新道理啊！他用权柄吩咐污鬼，连污鬼也听从了他。」
1.en: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? What can this new doctrine be? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

1.zh: 耶稣的名声就传遍了加利利的四方。
1.en: The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

1.zh: 他们一出会堂，就同着雅各、约翰，进了西门和安得烈的家。
1.en: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

1.zh: 西门的岳母正害热病躺着，就有人告诉耶稣。
1.en: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

1.zh: 耶稣进前拉着她的手，扶她起来，热就退了，她就服事他们。
1.en: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

1.zh: 天晚日落的时候，有人带着一切害病的，和被鬼附的，来到耶稣跟前。
1.en: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

1.zh: 合城的人都聚集在门前。
1.en: All the city was gathered together at the door.

1.zh: 耶稣治好了许多害各样病的人，又赶出许多鬼，不许鬼说话，因为鬼认识他。
1.en: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

1.zh: 次日早晨，天未亮的时候，耶稣起来，到旷野地方去，在那里祷告。
1.en: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

1.zh: 西门和同伴追了他去，
1.en: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.

1.zh: 遇见了就对他说：「众人都找你。」
1.en: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”

1.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「我们可以往别处去，到邻近的乡村，我也好在那里传道，因为我是为这事出来的。」
1.en: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”

1.zh: 于是在加利利全地，进了会堂，传道，赶鬼。
1.en: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

1.zh: 有一个长大麻风的来求耶稣，向他跪下，说：「你若肯，必能叫我洁净了。」
1.en: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

1.zh: 耶稣动了慈心，就伸手摸他，说：「我肯，你洁净了吧！」
1.en: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

1.zh: 大麻风即时离开他，他就洁净了。
1.en: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

1.zh: 耶稣严严地嘱咐他，就打发他走，
1.en: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,

1.zh: 对他说：「你要谨慎，什么话都不可告诉人，只要去把身体给祭司察看，又因为你洁净了，献上摩西所吩咐的礼物，对众人作证据。」
1.en: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

1.zh: 那人出去，倒说许多的话，把这件事传扬开了，叫耶稣以后不得再明明地进城，只好在外边旷野地方。人从各处都就了他来。
1.en: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.

2.zh: 过了些日子，耶稣又进了迦百农。人听见他在房子里，
2.en: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

2.zh: 就有许多人聚集，甚至连门前都没有空地；耶稣就对他们讲道。
2.en: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

2.zh: 有人带着一个瘫子来见耶稣，是用四个人抬来的；
2.en: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

2.zh: 因为人多，不得近前，就把耶稣所在的房子，拆了房顶，既拆通了，就把瘫子连所躺卧的褥子都缒下来。
2.en: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

2.zh: 耶稣见他们的信心，就对瘫子说：「小子，你的罪赦了。」
2.en: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

2.zh: 有几个文士坐在那里，心里议论，说：
2.en: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

2.zh: 「这个人为什么这样说呢？他说僭妄的话了。除了　神以外，谁能赦罪呢？」
2.en: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

2.zh: 耶稣心中知道他们心里这样议论，就说：「你们心里为什么这样议论呢？
2.en: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

2.zh: 或对瘫子说『你的罪赦了』，或说『起来！拿你的褥子行走』，哪一样容易呢？
2.en: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?

2.zh: 但要叫你们知道，人子在地上有赦罪的权柄。」就对瘫子说：
2.en: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—

2.zh: 「我吩咐你，起来！拿你的褥子回家去吧。」
2.en: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

2.zh: 那人就起来，立刻拿着褥子，当众人面前出去了，以致众人都惊奇，归荣耀与　神，说：「我们从来没有见过这样的事！」
2.en: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

2.zh: 耶稣又出到海边去，众人都就了他来，他便教训他们。
2.en: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

2.zh: 耶稣经过的时候，看见亚勒腓的儿子利未坐在税关上，就对他说：「你跟从我来。」他就起来，跟从了耶稣。
2.en: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.

2.zh: 耶稣在利未家里坐席的时候，有好些税吏和罪人与耶稣并门徒一同坐席；因为这样的人多，他们也跟随耶稣。
2.en: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

2.zh: 法利赛人中的文士看见耶稣和罪人并税吏一同吃饭，就对他门徒说：「他和税吏并罪人一同吃喝吗？」
2.en: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”

2.zh: 耶稣听见，就对他们说：「康健的人用不着医生，有病的人才用得着。我来本不是召义人，乃是召罪人。」
2.en: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

2.zh: 当下，约翰的门徒和法利赛人禁食。他们来问耶稣说：「约翰的门徒和法利赛人的门徒禁食，你的门徒倒不禁食，这是为什么呢？」
2.en: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

2.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的时候，陪伴之人岂能禁食呢？新郎还同在，他们不能禁食。
2.en: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

2.zh: 但日子将到，新郎要离开他们，那日他们就要禁食。
2.en: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

2.zh: 没有人把新布缝在旧衣服上，恐怕所补上的新布带坏了旧衣服，破的就更大了。
2.en: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

2.zh: 也没有人把新酒装在旧皮袋里，恐怕酒把皮袋裂开，酒和皮袋就都坏了；惟把新酒装在新皮袋里。」
2.en: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

2.zh: 耶稣当安息日从麦地经过。他门徒行路的时候，掐了麦穗。
2.en: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

2.zh: 法利赛人对耶稣说：「看哪，他们在安息日为什么做不可做的事呢？」
2.en: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”

2.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「[经上记着]大卫和跟从他的人缺乏饥饿之时所做的事，你们没有念过吗？
2.en: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?

2.zh: 他当亚比亚他作大祭司的时候，怎么进了　神的殿，吃了陈设饼，又给跟从他的人吃。这饼除了祭司以外，人都不可吃。」
2.en: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”

2.zh: 又对他们说：「安息日是为人设立的，人不是为安息日设立的。
2.en: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

2.zh: 所以，人子也是安息日的主。」
2.en: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

3.zh: 耶稣又进了会堂，在那里有一个人枯干了一只手。
3.en: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.

3.zh: 众人窥探耶稣，在安息日医治不医治，意思是要控告耶稣。
3.en: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

3.zh: 耶稣对那枯干一只手的人说：「起来，站在当中。」
3.en: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”

3.zh: 又问众人说：「在安息日行善行恶，救命害命，哪样是可以的呢？」他们都不作声。
3.en: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.

3.zh: 耶稣怒目周围看他们，忧愁他们的心刚硬，就对那人说：「伸出手来！」他把手一伸，手就复了原。
3.en: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

3.zh: 法利赛人出去，同希律一党的人商议怎样可以除灭耶稣。
3.en: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

3.zh: 耶稣和门徒退到海边去，有许多人从加利利跟随他。
3.en: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

3.zh: 还有许多人听见他所做的大事，就从犹太、耶路撒冷、以土买、约旦河外，并泰尔、西顿的四方来到他那里。
3.en: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

3.zh: 他因为人多，就吩咐门徒叫一只小船伺候着，免得众人拥挤他。
3.en: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

3.zh: 他治好了许多人，所以凡有灾病的，都挤进来要摸他。
3.en: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

3.zh: 污鬼无论何时看见他，就俯伏在他面前，喊着说：「你是　神的儿子。」
3.en: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

3.zh: 耶稣再三地嘱咐他们，不要把他显露出来。
3.en: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

3.zh: 耶稣上了山，随自己的意思叫人来；他们便来到他那里。
3.en: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

3.zh: 他就设立十二个人，要他们常和自己同在，也要差他们去传道，
3.en: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

3.zh: 并给他们权柄赶鬼。
3.en: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

3.zh: [这十二个人]有西门（耶稣又给他起名叫彼得），
3.en: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

3.zh: 还有西庇太的儿子雅各和雅各的兄弟约翰（又给这两个人起名叫半尼其，就是雷子的意思），
3.en: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

3.zh: 又有安得烈、腓力、巴多罗买、马太、多马、亚勒腓的儿子雅各，和达太，并奋锐党的西门，
3.en: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

3.zh: 还有卖耶稣的加略人犹大。
3.en: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

3.zh: 耶稣进了一个屋子，众人又聚集，甚至他连饭也顾不得吃。
3.en: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

3.zh: 耶稣的亲属听见，就出来要拉住他，因为他们说他癫狂了。
3.en: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

3.zh: 从耶路撒冷下来的文士说：「他是被别西卜附着」；又说：「他是靠着鬼王赶鬼。」
3.en: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

3.zh: 耶稣叫他们来，用比喻对他们说：「撒但怎能赶出撒但呢？
3.en: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

3.zh: 若一国自相纷争，那国就站立不住；
3.en: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

3.zh: 若一家自相纷争，那家就站立不住。
3.en: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

3.zh: 若撒但自相攻打纷争，他就站立不住，必要灭亡。
3.en: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

3.zh: 没有人能进壮士家里，抢夺他的家具；必先捆住那壮士，才可以抢夺他的家。
3.en: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

3.zh: 我实在告诉你们，世人一切的罪和一切亵渎的话都可得赦免；
3.en: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

3.zh: 凡亵渎圣灵的，却永不得赦免，乃要担当永远的罪。」
3.en: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

3.zh: [这话是]因为他们说：「他是被污鬼附着的。」
3.en: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

3.zh: 当下，耶稣的母亲和弟兄来，站在外边，打发人去叫他。
3.en: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

3.zh: 有许多人在耶稣周围坐着，他们就告诉他说：「看哪，你母亲和你弟兄在外边找你。」
3.en: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

3.zh: 耶稣回答说：「谁是我的母亲？谁是我的弟兄？」
3.en: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

3.zh: 就四面观看那周围坐着的人，说：「看哪，我的母亲，我的弟兄。
3.en: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

3.zh: 凡遵行　神旨意的人就是我的弟兄姊妹和母亲了。」
3.en: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”

4.zh: 耶稣又在海边教训人。有许多人到他那里聚集，他只得上船坐下。船在海里，众人都靠近海，站在岸上。
4.en: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

4.zh: 耶稣就用比喻教训他们许多道理。在教训之间，对他们说：
4.en: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

4.zh: 「你们听啊！有一个撒种的出去撒种。
4.en: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.

4.zh: 撒的时候，有落在路旁的，飞鸟来吃尽了；
4.en: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.

4.zh: 有落在土浅石头地上的，土既不深，发苗最快，
4.en: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

4.zh: 日头出来一晒，因为没有根，就枯干了；
4.en: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

4.zh: 有落在荆棘里的，荆棘长起来，把它挤住了，就不结实；
4.en: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

4.zh: 又有落在好土里的，就发生长大，结实有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的」；
4.en: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

4.zh: 又说：「有耳可听的，就应当听！」
4.en: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”

4.zh: 无人的时候，跟随耶稣的人和十二个门徒问他这比喻的意思。
4.en: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

4.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「　神国的奥秘只叫你们知道，若是对外人讲，凡事就用比喻，
4.en: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

4.zh: 叫他们 看是看见，却不晓得； 听是听见，却不明白； 恐怕他们回转过来，就得赦免。」
4.en: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

4.zh: 又对他们说：「你们不明白这比喻吗？这样怎能明白一切的比喻呢？
4.en: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

4.zh: 撒种之人所撒的就是道。
4.en: The farmer sows the word.

4.zh: 那撒在路旁的，就是人听了道，撒但立刻来，把撒在他心里的道夺了去。
4.en: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

4.zh: 那撒在石头地上的，就是人听了道，立刻欢喜领受，
4.en: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

4.zh: 但他心里没有根，不过是暂时的，及至为道遭了患难，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。
4.en: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

4.zh: 还有那撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，
4.en: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

4.zh: 后来有世上的思虑、钱财的迷惑，和别样的私欲进来，把道挤住了，就不能结实。
4.en: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

4.zh: 那撒在好地上的，就是人听道，又领受，并且结实，有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的。」
4.en: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

4.zh: 耶稣又对他们说：「人拿灯来，岂是要放在斗底下，床底下，不放在灯台上吗？
4.en: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?

4.zh: 因为掩藏的事，没有不显出来的；隐瞒的事，没有不露出来的。
4.en: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.

4.zh: 有耳可听的，就应当听！」
4.en: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

4.zh: 又说：「你们所听的要留心。你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们，并且要多给你们。
4.en: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.

4.zh: 因为有的，还要给他；没有的，连他所有的也要夺去。」
4.en: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

4.zh: 又说：「　神的国如同人把种撒在地上。
4.en: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

4.zh: 黑夜睡觉，白日起来，这种就发芽渐长，那人却不晓得如何这样。
4.en: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.

4.zh: 地生五谷是出于自然的：先发苗，后长穗，再后穗上结成饱满的子粒；
4.en: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

4.zh: 谷既熟了，就用镰刀去割，因为收成的时候到了。」
4.en: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

4.zh: 又说：「　神的国，我们可用什么比较呢？可用什么比喻表明呢？
4.en: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

4.zh: 好像一粒芥菜种，种在地里的时候，虽比地上的百种都小，
4.en: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

4.zh: 但种上以后，就长起来，比各样的菜都大，又长出大枝来，甚至天上的飞鸟可以宿在它的荫下。」
4.en: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

4.zh: 耶稣用许多这样的比喻，照他们所能听的，对他们讲道。
4.en: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

4.zh: 若不用比喻，就不对他们讲；没有人的时候，就把一切的道讲给门徒听。
4.en: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

4.zh: 当那天晚上，耶稣对门徒说：「我们渡到那边去吧。」
4.en: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

4.zh: 门徒离开众人，耶稣仍在船上，他们就把他一同带去；也有别的船和他同行。
4.en: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

4.zh: 忽然起了暴风，波浪打入船内，甚至船要满了水。
4.en: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

4.zh: 耶稣在船尾上，枕着枕头睡觉。门徒叫醒了他，说：「夫子！我们丧命，你不顾吗？」
4.en: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

4.zh: 耶稣醒了，斥责风，向海说：「住了吧！静了吧！」风就止住，大大地平静了。
4.en: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

4.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「为什么胆怯？你们还没有信心吗？」
4.en: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

4.zh: 他们就大大地惧怕，彼此说：「这到底是谁，连风和海也听从他了。」
4.en: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

5.zh: 他们来到海那边格拉森人的地方。
5.en: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

5.zh: 耶稣一下船，就有一个被污鬼附着的人从坟茔里出来迎着他。
5.en: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

5.zh: 那人常住在坟茔里，没有人能捆住他，就是用铁链也不能；
5.en: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

5.zh: 因为人屡次用脚镣和铁链捆锁他，铁链竟被他挣断了，脚镣也被他弄碎了；总没有人能制伏他。
5.en: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

5.zh: 他昼夜常在坟茔里和山中喊叫，又用石头砍自己。
5.en: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

5.zh: 他远远地看见耶稣，就跑过去拜他，
5.en: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

5.zh: 大声呼叫说：「至高　神的儿子耶稣，我与你有什么相干？我指着　神恳求你，不要叫我受苦！」
5.en: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

5.zh: 是因耶稣曾吩咐他说：「污鬼啊，从这人身上出来吧！」
5.en: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

5.zh: 耶稣问他说：「你名叫什么？」回答说：「我名叫『群』，因为我们多的缘故」；
5.en: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

5.zh: 就再三地求耶稣，不要叫他们离开那地方。
5.en: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

5.zh: 在那里山坡上，有一大群猪吃食；
5.en: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

5.zh: 鬼就央求耶稣说：「求你打发我们往猪群里，附着猪去。」
5.en: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

5.zh: 耶稣准了他们，污鬼就出来，进入猪里去。于是那群猪闯下山崖，投在海里，淹死了。[猪的数目]约有二千。
5.en: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

5.zh: 放猪的就逃跑了，去告诉城里和乡下的人。众人就来，要看是什么事。
5.en: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

5.zh: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见那被鬼附着的人，就是从前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心里明白过来，他们就害怕。
5.en: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

5.zh: 看见这事的，便将鬼附之人所遇见的和那群猪的事都告诉了众人；
5.en: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

5.zh: 众人就央求耶稣离开他们的境界。
5.en: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

5.zh: 耶稣上船的时候，那从前被鬼附着的人恳求和耶稣同在。
5.en: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

5.zh: 耶稣不许，却对他说：「你回家去，到你的亲属那里，将主为你所做的是何等大的事，是怎样怜悯你，都告诉他们。」
5.en: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

5.zh: 那人就走了，在低加坡里传扬耶稣为他做了何等大的事，众人就都希奇。
5.en: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

5.zh: 耶稣坐船又渡到那边去，就有许多人到他那里聚集；他正在海边上。
5.en: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

5.zh: 有一个管会堂的人，名叫睚鲁，来见耶稣，就俯伏在他脚前，
5.en: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet

5.zh: 再三地求他，说：「我的小女儿快要死了，[求你]去按手在她身上，使她痊愈，得以活了。」
5.en: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”

5.zh: 耶稣就和他同去。 有许多人跟随拥挤他。
5.en: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

5.zh: 有一个女人，患了十二年的血漏，
5.en: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,

5.zh: 在好些医生手里受了许多的苦，又花尽了她所有的，一点也不见好，病势反倒更重了。
5.en: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

5.zh: 她听见耶稣的事，就从后头来，杂在众人中间，摸耶稣的衣裳，
5.en: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.

5.zh: 意思说：「我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊愈。」
5.en: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

5.zh: 于是她血漏的源头立刻干了；她便觉得身上的灾病好了。
5.en: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

5.zh: 耶稣顿时心里觉得有能力从自己身上出去，就在众人中间转过来，说：「谁摸我的衣裳？」
5.en: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

5.zh: 门徒对他说：「你看众人拥挤你，还说『谁摸我』吗？」
5.en: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

5.zh: 耶稣周围观看，要见做这事的女人。
5.en: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

5.zh: 那女人知道在自己身上所成的事，就恐惧战兢，来俯伏在耶稣跟前，将实情全告诉他。
5.en: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

5.zh: 耶稣对她说：「女儿，你的信救了你，平平安安地回去吧！你的灾病痊愈了。」
5.en: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

5.zh: 还说话的时候，有人从管会堂的家里来，说：「你的女儿死了，何必还劳动先生呢？」
5.en: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

5.zh: 耶稣听见所说的话，就对管会堂的说：「不要怕，只要信！」
5.en: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

5.zh: 于是带着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰同去，不许别人跟随他。
5.en: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

5.zh: 他们来到管会堂的家里；耶稣看见那里乱嚷，并有人大大地哭泣哀号，
5.en: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

5.zh: 进到里面，就对他们说：「为什么乱嚷哭泣呢？孩子不是死了，是睡着了。」
5.en: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

5.zh: 他们就嗤笑耶稣。耶稣把他们都撵出去，就带着孩子的父母和跟随的人进了孩子所在的地方，
5.en: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

5.zh: 就拉着孩子的手，对她说：「大利大，古米！」（翻出来就是说：「闺女，我吩咐你起来！」）
5.en: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”

5.zh: 那闺女立时起来走。他们就大大地惊奇；闺女已经十二岁了。
5.en: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

5.zh: 耶稣切切地嘱咐他们，不要叫人知道这事，又吩咐给她东西吃。
5.en: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

6.zh: 耶稣离开那里，来到自己的家乡；门徒也跟从他。
6.en: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

6.zh: 到了安息日，他在会堂里教训人。众人听见，就甚希奇，说：「这人从哪里有这些事呢？所赐给他的是什么智慧？他手所做的是何等的异能呢？
6.en: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

6.zh: 这不是那木匠吗？不是马利亚的儿子雅各、约西、犹大、西门的长兄吗？他妹妹们不也是在我们这里吗？」他们就厌弃他。
6.en: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

6.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「大凡先知，除了本地、亲属、本家之外，没有不被人尊敬的。」
6.en: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

6.zh: 耶稣就在那里不得行什么异能，不过按手在几个病人身上，治好他们。
6.en: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

6.zh: 他也诧异他们不信，就往周围乡村教训人去了。
6.en: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

6.zh: 耶稣叫了十二个门徒来，差遣他们两个两个地出去，也赐给他们权柄，制伏污鬼；
6.en: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

6.zh: 并且嘱咐他们：「行路的时候不要带食物和口袋，腰袋里也不要带钱，除了拐杖以外，什么都不要带；
6.en: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

6.zh: 只要穿鞋，也不要穿两件褂子」；
6.en: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

6.zh: 又对他们说：「你们无论到何处，进了人的家，就住在那里，直到离开那地方。
6.en: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

6.zh: 何处的人不接待你们，不听你们，你们离开那里的时候，就把脚上的尘土跺下去，对他们作见证。」
6.en: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

6.zh: 门徒就出去传道，叫人悔改，
6.en: They went out and preached that people should repent.

6.zh: 又赶出许多的鬼，用油抹了许多病人，治好他们。
6.en: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.

6.zh: 耶稣的名声传扬出来。希律王听见了，就说：「施洗的约翰从死里复活了，所以这些异能由他里面发出来。」
6.en: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

6.zh: 但别人说：「是以利亚。」又有人说：「是先知，[正]像先知中的一位。」
6.en: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

6.zh: 希律听见却说：「是我所斩的约翰，他复活了。」
6.en: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

6.zh: 先是希律为他兄弟腓力的妻子希罗底的缘故，差人去拿住约翰，锁在监里，因为希律已经娶了那妇人。
6.en: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

6.zh: 约翰曾对希律说：「你娶你兄弟的妻子是不合理的。」
6.en: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

6.zh: 于是希罗底怀恨他，想要杀他，只是不能；
6.en: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,

6.zh: 因为希律知道约翰是义人，是圣人，所以敬畏他，保护他，听他讲论，就多照着行，并且乐意听他。
6.en: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

6.zh: 有一天，恰巧是希律的生日，希律摆设筵席，请了大臣和千夫长，并加利利作首领的。
6.en: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

6.zh: 希罗底的女儿进来跳舞，使希律和同席的人都欢喜。王就对女子说：「你随意向我求什么，我必给你。」
6.en: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

6.zh: 又对她起誓说：「随你向我求什么，就是我国的一半，我也必给你。」
6.en: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

6.zh: 她就出去对她母亲说：「我可以求什么呢？」她母亲说：「施洗约翰的头。」
6.en: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”

6.zh: 她就急忙进去见王，求他说：「我愿王立时把施洗约翰的头放在盘子里给我。」
6.en: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

6.zh: 王就甚忧愁；但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就不肯推辞，
6.en: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

6.zh: 随即差一个护卫兵，吩咐拿约翰的头来。护卫兵就去，在监里斩了约翰，
6.en: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

6.zh: 把头放在盘子里，拿来给女子，女子就给她母亲。
6.en: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

6.zh: 约翰的门徒听见了，就来把他的尸首领去，葬在坟墓里。
6.en: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

6.zh: 使徒聚集到耶稣那里，将一切所做的事、所传的道全告诉他。
6.en: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

6.zh: 他就说：「你们来，同我暗暗地到旷野地方去歇一歇。」这是因为来往的人多，他们连吃饭也没有工夫。
6.en: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

6.zh: 他们就坐船，暗暗地往旷野地方去。
6.en: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

6.zh: [众人]看见他们去，有许多认识他们的，就从各城步行，一同跑到那里，比他们先赶到了。
6.en: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

6.zh: 耶稣出来，见有许多的人，就怜悯他们，因为他们如同羊没有牧人一般，于是开口教训他们许多道理。
6.en: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

6.zh: 天已经晚了，门徒进前来，说：「这是野地，天已经晚了，
6.en: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

6.zh: 请叫众人散开，他们好往四面乡村里去，自己买什么吃。」
6.en: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

6.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们给他们吃吧。」门徒说：「我们可以去买二十两银子的饼给他们吃吗？」
6.en: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

6.zh: 耶稣说：「你们有多少饼，可以去看看。」他们知道了，就说：「五个饼，两条鱼。」
6.en: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

6.zh: 耶稣吩咐他们，叫众人一帮一帮地坐在青草地上。
6.en: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

6.zh: 众人就一排一排地坐下，有一百一排的，有五十一排的。
6.en: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

6.zh: 耶稣拿着这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开饼，递给门徒，摆在众人面前，也把那两条鱼分给众人。
6.en: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

6.zh: 他们都吃，并且吃饱了。
6.en: They all ate and were filled.

6.zh: 门徒就把碎饼碎鱼收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。
6.en: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

6.zh: 吃饼的男人共有五千。
6.en: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

6.zh: 耶稣随即催门徒上船，先渡到那边伯赛大去，等他叫众人散开。
6.en: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

6.zh: 他既辞别了他们，就往山上去祷告。
6.en: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

6.zh: 到了晚上，船在海中，耶稣独自在岸上；
6.en: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

6.zh: 看见门徒因风不顺，摇橹甚苦。夜里约有四更天，就在海面上走，往他们那里去，意思要走过他们去。
6.en: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,

6.zh: 但门徒看见他在海面上走，以为是鬼怪，就喊叫起来；
6.en: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

6.zh: 因为他们都看见了他，且甚惊慌。耶稣连忙对他们说：「你们放心！是我，不要怕！」
6.en: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

6.zh: 于是到他们那里，上了船，风就住了；他们心里十分惊奇。
6.en: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

6.zh: 这是因为他们不明白那分饼的事，心里还是愚顽。
6.en: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

6.zh: 既渡过去，来到革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸，
6.en: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.

6.zh: 一下船，众人认得是耶稣，
6.en: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

6.zh: 就跑遍那一带地方，听见他在何处，便将有病的人用褥子抬到那里。
6.en: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

6.zh: 凡耶稣所到的地方，或村中，或城里，或乡间，他们都将病人放在街市上，求耶稣只容他们摸他的衣裳 子；凡摸着的人就都好了。
6.en: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

7.zh: 有法利赛人和几个文士从耶路撒冷来，到耶稣那里聚集。
7.en: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

7.zh: 他们曾看见他的门徒中有人用俗手，就是没有洗的手，吃饭。（
7.en: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

7.zh: 原来法利赛人和犹太人都拘守古人的遗传，若不仔细洗手就不吃饭；
7.en: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

7.zh: 从市上来，若不洗浴也不吃饭；还有好些别的规矩，他们历代拘守，就是洗杯、罐、铜器[等物]。）
7.en: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

7.zh: 法利赛人和文士问他说：「你的门徒为什么不照古人的遗传，用俗手吃饭呢？」
7.en: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”

7.zh: 耶稣说：「以赛亚指着你们假冒为善之人所说的预言是不错的。如经上说： 这百姓用嘴唇尊敬我， 心却远离我。
7.en: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

7.zh: 他们将人的吩咐当作道理教导人， 所以拜我也是枉然。
7.en: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’

7.zh: 你们是离弃　神的诫命，拘守人的遗传」；
7.en: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”

7.zh: 又说：「你们诚然是废弃　神的诫命，要守自己的遗传。
7.en: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

7.zh: 摩西说：『当孝敬父母』；又说：『咒骂父母的，必治死他。』
7.en: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

7.zh: 你们倒说：『人若对父母说：我所当奉给你的，已经作了各耳板』（各耳板就是供献的意思），
7.en: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,

7.zh: 以后你们就不容他再奉养父母。
7.en: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

7.zh: 这就是你们承接遗传，废了　神的道。你们还做许多这样的事。」
7.en: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”

7.zh: 耶稣又叫众人来，对他们说：「你们都要听我的话，也要明白。
7.en: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.

7.zh: 从外面进去的不能污秽人，惟有从里面出来的乃能污秽人。」
7.en: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”

7.zh: 耶稣离开众人，进了屋子，门徒就问他这比喻的意思。
7.en: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

7.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们也是这样不明白吗？岂不晓得凡从外面进入的，不能污秽人，
7.en: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,

7.zh: 因为不是入他的心，乃是入他的肚腹，又落到茅厕里（[这是说]，各样的食物都是洁净的）」；
7.en: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”

7.zh: 又说：「从人里面出来的，那才能污秽人；
7.en: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

7.zh: 因为从里面，就是从人心里，发出恶念、苟合、
7.en: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

7.zh: 偷盗、凶杀、奸淫、贪婪、邪恶、诡诈、淫荡、嫉妒、谤 、骄傲、狂妄。
7.en: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

7.zh: 这一切的恶都是从里面出来，且能污秽人。」
7.en: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”

7.zh: 耶稣从那里起身，往泰尔、西顿的境内去，进了一家，不愿意人知道，却隐藏不住。
7.en: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

7.zh: 当下，有一个妇人，她的小女儿被污鬼附着，听见耶稣的事，就来俯伏在他脚前。
7.en: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

7.zh: 这妇人是希腊人，属叙利腓尼基族。她求耶稣赶出那鬼离开她的女儿。
7.en: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

7.zh: 耶稣对她说：「让儿女们先吃饱，不好拿儿女的饼丢给狗吃。」
7.en: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

7.zh: 妇人回答说：「主啊，不错；但是狗在桌子底下也吃孩子们的碎渣儿。」
7.en: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

7.zh: 耶稣对她说：「因这句话，你回去吧；鬼已经离开你的女儿了。」
7.en: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

7.zh: 她就回家去，见小孩子躺在床上，鬼已经出去了。
7.en: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

7.zh: 耶稣又离了泰尔的境界，经过西顿，就从低加坡里境内来到加利利 海。
7.en: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.

7.zh: 有人带着一个耳聋舌结的人来见耶稣，求他按手在他身上。
7.en: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

7.zh: 耶稣领他离开众人，到一边去，就用指头探他的耳朵，吐唾沫抹他的舌头，
7.en: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.

7.zh: 望天叹息，对他说：「以法大！」就是说：「开了吧！」
7.en: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

7.zh: 他的耳朵就开了，舌结也解了，说话也清楚了。
7.en: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

7.zh: 耶稣嘱咐他们不要告诉人；但他越发嘱咐，他们越发传扬开了。
7.en: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

7.zh: 众人分外希奇，说：「他所做的事都好，他连聋子也叫他们听见，哑巴也叫他们说话。」
7.en: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

8.zh: 那时，又有许多人聚集，并没有什么吃的。耶稣叫门徒来，说：
8.en: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

8.zh: 「我怜悯这众人；因为他们同我在这里已经三天，也没有吃的了。
8.en: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

8.zh: 我若打发他们饿着回家，就必在路上困乏，因为其中有从远处来的。」
8.en: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

8.zh: 门徒回答说：「在这野地，从哪里能得饼，叫这些人吃饱呢？」
8.en: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

8.zh: 耶稣问他们说：「你们有多少饼？」他们说：「七个。」
8.en: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

8.zh: 他吩咐众人坐在地上，就拿着这七个饼祝谢了，擘开，递给门徒，叫他们摆开，门徒就摆在众人面前。
8.en: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

8.zh: 又有几条小鱼；耶稣祝了福，就吩咐也摆在众人面前。
8.en: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

8.zh: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了，收拾剩下的零碎，有七筐子。
8.en: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

8.zh: 人数约有四千。耶稣打发他们走了，
8.en: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

8.zh: 随即同门徒上船，来到大玛努他境内。
8.en: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

8.zh: 法利赛人出来盘问耶稣，求他从天上显个神迹给他们看，想要试探他。
8.en: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

8.zh: 耶稣心里深深地叹息，说：「这世代为什么求神迹呢？我实在告诉你们，没有神迹给这世代看。」
8.en: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

8.zh: 他就离开他们，又上[船]往海那边去了。
8.en: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

8.zh: 门徒忘了带饼；在船上除了一个饼，没有别的食物。
8.en: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

8.zh: 耶稣嘱咐他们说：「你们要谨慎，防备法利赛人的酵和希律的酵。」
8.en: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

8.zh: 他们彼此议论说：「[这是因为]我们没有饼吧。」
8.en: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

8.zh: 耶稣看出来，就说：「你们为什么因为没有饼就议论呢？你们还不省悟，还不明白吗？你们的心还是愚顽吗？
8.en: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

8.zh: 你们有眼睛，看不见吗？有耳朵，听不见吗？也不记得吗？
8.en: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

8.zh: 我擘开那五个饼分给五千人，你们收拾的零碎装满了多少篮子呢？」他们说：「十二个。」
8.en: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

8.zh: 「[又擘开]那七个饼分给四千人，你们收拾的零碎装满了多少筐子呢？」他们说：「七个。」
8.en: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

8.zh: 耶稣说：「你们还是不明白吗？」
8.en: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

8.zh: 他们来到伯赛大，有人带一个瞎子来，求耶稣摸他。
8.en: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

8.zh: 耶稣拉着瞎子的手，领他到村外，就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，问他说：「你看见什么了？」
8.en: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

8.zh: 他就抬头一看，说：「我看见人了；他们好像树木，并且行走。」
8.en: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

8.zh: 随后又按手在他眼睛上，他定睛一看，就复了原，样样都看得清楚了。
8.en: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

8.zh: 耶稣打发他回家，说：「连这村子你也不要进去。」
8.en: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

8.zh: 耶稣和门徒出去，往凯撒利亚·腓立比村庄去；在路上问门徒说：「人说我是谁？」
8.en: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”

8.zh: 他们说：「[有人说]是施洗的约翰；有人说是以利亚；又有人说是先知里的一位。」
8.en: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

8.zh: 又问他们说：「你们说我是谁？」彼得回答说：「你是基督。」
8.en: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

8.zh: 耶稣就禁戒他们，不要告诉人。
8.en: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

8.zh: 从此，他教训他们说：「人子必须受许多的苦，被长老、祭司长，和文士弃绝，并且被杀，过三天复活。」
8.en: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

8.zh: 耶稣明明地说这话，彼得就拉着他，劝他。
8.en: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

8.zh: 耶稣转过来，看着门徒，就责备彼得说：「撒但，退我后边去吧！因为你不体贴　神的意思，只体贴人的意思。」
8.en: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

8.zh: 于是叫众人和门徒来，对他们说：「若有人要跟从我，就当舍己，背起他的十字架来跟从我。
8.en: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

8.zh: 因为，凡要救自己生命的，必丧掉生命；凡为我和福音丧掉生命的，必救了生命。
8.en: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

8.zh: 人就是赚得全世界，赔上自己的生命，有什么益处呢？
8.en: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

8.zh: 人还能拿什么换生命呢？
8.en: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

8.zh: 凡在这淫乱罪恶的世代，把我和我的道当作可耻的，人子在他父的荣耀里，同圣天使降临的时候，也要把那人当作可耻的。」
8.en: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

9.zh: 耶稣又对他们说：「我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没尝死味以前，必要看见　神的国大有能力临到。」
9.en: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

9.zh: 过了六天，耶稣带着彼得、雅各、约翰暗暗地上了高山，就在他们面前变了形象，
9.en: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

9.zh: 衣服放光，极其洁白，地上漂布的，没有一个能漂得那样白。
9.en: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

9.zh: [忽然]，有以利亚同摩西向他们显现，并且和耶稣说话。
9.en: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

9.zh: 彼得对耶稣说：「拉比，我们在这里真好！可以搭三座棚，一座为你，一座为摩西，一座为以利亚。」
9.en: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

9.zh: 彼得不知道说什么才好，因为他们甚是惧怕。
9.en: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.

9.zh: 有一朵云彩来遮盖他们；也有声音从云彩里出来，说：「这是我的爱子，你们要听他。」
9.en: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”

9.zh: 门徒忽然周围一看，不再见一人，只见耶稣同他们在那里。
9.en: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

9.zh: 下山的时候，耶稣嘱咐他们说：「人子还没有从死里复活，你们不要将所看见的告诉人。」
9.en: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

9.zh: 门徒将这话存记在心，彼此议论「从死里复活」是什么意思。
9.en: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

9.zh: 他们就问耶稣说：「文士为什么说以利亚必须先来？」
9.en: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

9.zh: 耶稣说：「以利亚固然先来复兴万事；[经上]不是指着人子说，他要受许多的苦被人轻慢呢？
9.en: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

9.zh: 我告诉你们，以利亚已经来了，他们也任意待他，正如[经上]所指着他的话。」
9.en: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

9.zh: 耶稣到了门徒那里，看见有许多人围着他们，又有文士和他们辩论。
9.en: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

9.zh: 众人一见耶稣，都甚希奇，就跑上去问他的安。
9.en: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

9.zh: 耶稣问他们说：「你们和他们辩论的是什么？」
9.en: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

9.zh: 众人中间有一个人回答说：「夫子，我带了我的儿子到你这里来，他被哑巴鬼附着。
9.en: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

9.zh: 无论在哪里，鬼捉弄他，把他摔倒，他就口中流沫，咬牙切齿，身体枯干。我请过你的门徒把鬼赶出去，他们却是不能。」
9.en: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”

9.zh: 耶稣说：「嗳！不信的世代啊，我在你们这里要到几时呢？我忍耐你们要到几时呢？把他带到我这里来吧。」
9.en: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”

9.zh: 他们就带了他来。他一见耶稣，鬼便叫他重重地抽风，倒在地上，翻来覆去，口中流沫。
9.en: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

9.zh: 耶稣问他父亲说：「他得这病有多少日子呢？」回答说：「从小的时候。
9.en: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.

9.zh: 鬼屡次把他扔在火里、水里，要灭他。你若能做什么，求你怜悯我们，帮助我们。」
9.en: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

9.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你若能[信]，在信的人，凡事都能。」
9.en: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

9.zh: 孩子的父亲立时喊着说：「我信！但我信不足，求主帮助。」
9.en: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

9.zh: 耶稣看见众人都跑上来，就斥责那污鬼，说：「你这聋哑的鬼，我吩咐你从他里头出来，再不要进去！」
9.en: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

9.zh: 那鬼喊叫，使孩子大大地抽了一阵风，就出来了。[孩子]好像死了一般，以致众人多半说：「他是死了。」
9.en: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”

9.zh: 但耶稣拉着他的手，扶他起来，他就站起来了。
9.en: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.

9.zh: 耶稣进了屋子，门徒就暗暗地问他说：「我们为什么不能赶出他去呢？」
9.en: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”

9.zh: 耶稣说：「非用祷告，这一类的[鬼]总不能出来。」
9.en: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”

9.zh: 他们离开那地方，经过加利利；耶稣不愿意人知道。
9.en: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,

9.zh: 于是教训门徒，说：「人子将要被交在人手里，他们要杀害他；被杀以后，过三天他要复活。」
9.en: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”

9.zh: 门徒却不明白这话，又不敢问他。
9.en: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

9.zh: 他们来到迦百农。耶稣在屋里问门徒说：「你们在路上议论的是什么？」
9.en: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

9.zh: 门徒不作声，因为他们在路上彼此争论谁为大。
9.en: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.

9.zh: 耶稣坐下，叫十二个门徒来，说：「若有人愿意作首先的，他必作众人末后的，作众人的用人。」
9.en: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

9.zh: 于是领过一个小孩子来，叫他站在门徒中间，又抱起他来，对他们说：
9.en: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

9.zh: 「凡为我名接待一个像这小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，不是接待我，乃是接待那差我来的。」
9.en: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

9.zh: 约翰对耶稣说：「夫子，我们看见一个人奉你的名赶鬼，我们就禁止他，因为他不跟从我们。」
9.en: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

9.zh: 耶稣说：「不要禁止他；因为没有人奉我名行异能，反倒轻易毁谤我。
9.en: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

9.zh: 不敌挡我们的，就是帮助我们的。
9.en: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

9.zh: 凡因你们是属基督，给你们一杯水喝的，我实在告诉你们，他不能不得赏赐。」
9.en: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

9.zh: 「凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，扔在海里。
9.en: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

9.zh: 倘若你一只手叫你跌倒，就把它砍下来；
9.en: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

9.zh: 你缺了肢体进入[永]生，强如有两[只]手落到地狱，入那不灭的火里去。
9.en: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

9.zh: 倘若你一只脚叫你跌倒，就把它砍下来；
9.en: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—

9.zh: 你瘸腿进入[永]生，强如有两只脚被丢在地狱里。
9.en: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

9.zh: 倘若你一只眼叫你跌倒，就去掉它；你只有一只眼进入　神的国，强如有两只眼被丢在地狱里。
9.en: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

9.zh: 在那里，虫是不死的，火是不灭的。
9.en: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

9.zh: 因为必用火当盐腌各人。
9.en: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

9.zh: 盐本是好的，若失了味，可用什么叫它再咸呢？你们里头应当有盐，彼此和睦。」
9.en: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

10.zh: 耶稣从那里起身，来到犹太的境界并约旦河外。众人又聚集到他那里，他又照常教训他们。
10.en: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

10.zh: 有法利赛人来问他说：「人休妻可以不可以？」意思要试探他。
10.en: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

10.zh: 耶稣回答说：「摩西吩咐你们的是什么？」
10.en: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

10.zh: 他们说：「摩西许人写了休书便可以休妻。」
10.en: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

10.zh: 耶稣说：「摩西因为你们的心硬，所以写这条例给你们；
10.en: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

10.zh: 但从起初创造的时候，　神造人是造男造女。
10.en: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

10.zh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。
10.en: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

10.zh: 既然如此，夫妻不再是两个人，乃是一体的了。
10.en: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

10.zh: 所以，　神配合的，人不可分开。」
10.en: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”

10.zh: 到了屋里，门徒就问他这事。
10.en: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

10.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「凡休妻另娶的，就是犯奸淫，辜负他的妻子；
10.en: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

10.zh: 妻子若离弃丈夫另嫁，也是犯奸淫了。」
10.en: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

10.zh: 有人带着小孩子来见耶稣，要耶稣摸他们，门徒便责备那些人。
10.en: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

10.zh: 耶稣看见就恼怒，对门徒说：「让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们；因为在　神国的，正是这样的人。
10.en: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

10.zh: 我实在告诉你们，凡要承受　神国的，若不像小孩子，断不能进去。」
10.en: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

10.zh: 于是抱着小孩子，给他们按手，为他们祝福。
10.en: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

10.zh: 耶稣出来行路的时候，有一个人跑来，跪在他面前，问他说：「良善的夫子，我当做什么事才可以承受永生？」
10.en: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

10.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你为什么称我是良善的？除了　神一位之外，再没有良善的。
10.en: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

10.zh: 诫命你是晓得的：不可杀人；不可奸淫；不可偷盗；不可作假见证；不可亏负人；当孝敬父母。」
10.en: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”

10.zh: 他对耶稣说：「夫子，这一切我从小都遵守了。」
10.en: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

10.zh: 耶稣看着他，就爱他，对他说：「你还缺少一件：去变卖你所有的，分给穷人，就必有财宝在天上；你还要来跟从我。」
10.en: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”

10.zh: 他听见这话，脸上就变了色，忧忧愁愁地走了，因为他的产业很多。
10.en: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

10.zh: 耶稣周围一看，对门徒说：「有钱财的人进　神的国是何等地难哪！」
10.en: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

10.zh: 门徒希奇他的话。耶稣又对他们说：「小子，倚靠钱财的人进　神的国是何等地难哪！
10.en: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

10.zh: 骆驼穿过针的眼，比财主进　神的国还容易呢。」
10.en: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

10.zh: 门徒就分外希奇，对他说：「这样谁能得救呢？」
10.en: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

10.zh: 耶稣看着他们，说：「在人是不能，在　神却不然，因为　神凡事都能。」
10.en: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

10.zh: 彼得就对他说：「看哪，我们已经撇下所有的跟从你了。」
10.en: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”

10.zh: 耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，人为我和福音撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姊妹、父母、儿女、田地，
10.en: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

10.zh: 没有不在今世得百倍的，就是房屋、弟兄、姊妹、母亲、儿女、田地，并且要受逼迫，在来世必得永生。
10.en: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

10.zh: 然而，有许多在前的，将要在后，在后的，将要在前。」
10.en: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”

10.zh: 他们行路上耶路撒冷去。耶稣在前头走，门徒就希奇，跟从的人也害怕。耶稣又叫过十二个门徒来，把自己将要遭遇的事告诉他们说：
10.en: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

10.zh: 「看哪，我们上耶路撒冷去，人子将要被交给祭司长和文士，他们要定他死罪，交给外邦人。
10.en: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.

10.zh: 他们要戏弄他，吐唾沫在他脸上，鞭打他，杀害他。过了三天，他要复活。」
10.en: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

10.zh: 西庇太的儿子雅各、约翰进前来，对耶稣说：「夫子，我们无论求你什么，愿你给我们做。」
10.en: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

10.zh: 耶稣说：「要我给你们做什么？」
10.en: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

10.zh: 他们说：「赐我们在你的荣耀里，一个坐在你右边，一个坐在你左边。」
10.en: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

10.zh: 耶稣说：「你们不知道所求的是什么。我所喝的杯，你们能喝吗？我所受的洗，你们能受吗？」
10.en: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

10.zh: 他们说：「我们能。」耶稣说：「我所喝的杯，你们也要喝；我所受的洗，你们也要受；
10.en: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

10.zh: 只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以赐的，乃是为谁预备的，就赐给谁。」
10.en: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

10.zh: 那十个门徒听见，就恼怒雅各、约翰。
10.en: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

10.zh: 耶稣叫他们来，对他们说：「你们知道，外邦人有尊为君王的，治理他们，有大臣操权管束他们。
10.en: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

10.zh: 只是在你们中间，不是这样。你们中间，谁愿为大，就必作你们的用人；
10.en: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

10.zh: 在你们中间，谁愿为首，就必作众人的仆人。
10.en: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

10.zh: 因为人子来，并不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，并且要舍命作多人的赎价。」
10.en: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

10.zh: 到了耶利哥；耶稣同门徒并许多人出耶利哥的时候，有一个讨饭的瞎子，是底买的儿子巴底买，坐在路旁。
10.en: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

10.zh: 他听见是拿撒勒的耶稣，就喊着说：「大卫的子孙耶稣啊！可怜我吧！」
10.en: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

10.zh: 有许多人责备他，不许他作声。他却越发大声喊着说：「大卫的子孙哪，可怜我吧！」
10.en: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

10.zh: 耶稣就站住，说：「叫过他来。」他们就叫那瞎子，对他说：「放心，起来！他叫你啦。」
10.en: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

10.zh: 瞎子就丢下衣服，跳起来，走到耶稣那里。
10.en: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

10.zh: 耶稣说：「要我为你做什么？」瞎子说：「拉波尼，我要能看见。」
10.en: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

10.zh: 耶稣说：「你去吧！你的信救了你了。」瞎子立刻看见了，就在路上跟随耶稣。
10.en: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.

11.zh: 耶稣和门徒将近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄榄山那里；耶稣就打发两个门徒，
11.en: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples

11.zh: 对他们说：「你们往对面村子里去，一进去的时候，必看见一匹驴驹拴在那里，是从来没有人骑过的，可以解开，牵来。
11.en: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.

11.zh: 若有人对你们说：『为什么做这事？』你们就说：『主要用它。』那人必立时让你们牵来。」
11.en: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”

11.zh: 他们去了，便看见一匹驴驹拴在门外街道上，就把它解开。
11.en: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

11.zh: 在那里站着的人，有几个说：「你们解驴驹做什么？」
11.en: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”

11.zh: 门徒照着耶稣所说的回答，那些人就任凭他们牵去了。
11.en: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

11.zh: 他们把驴驹牵到耶稣那里，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶稣就骑上。
11.en: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

11.zh: 有许多人把衣服铺在路上，也有人把田间的树枝砍下来，铺在路上。
11.en: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.

11.zh: 前行后随的人都喊着说： 和散那！ 奉主名来的是应当称颂的！
11.en: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

11.zh: 那将要来的我祖大卫之国是应当称颂的！ 高高在上和散那！
11.en: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

11.zh: 耶稣进了耶路撒冷，入了[圣]殿，周围看了各样物件。天色已晚，就和十二个门徒出城，往伯大尼去了。
11.en: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

11.zh: 第二天，他们从伯大尼出来，耶稣饿了。
11.en: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

11.zh: 远远地看见一棵无花果树，树上有叶子，就往那里去，或者在树上可以找着什么。到了树下，竟找不着什么，不过有叶子，因为不是收无花果的时候。
11.en: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

11.zh: 耶稣就对树说：「从今以后，永没有人吃你的果子。」他的门徒也听见了。
11.en: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

11.zh: 他们来到耶路撒冷。耶稣进入[圣]殿，赶出殿里做买卖的人，推倒兑换银钱之人的桌子和卖鸽子之人的凳子；
11.en: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

11.zh: 也不许人拿着器具从殿里经过；
11.en: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

11.zh: 便教训他们说：「[经上]不是记着说： 我的殿必称为万国祷告的殿吗？ 你们倒使它成为贼窝了。」
11.en: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”

11.zh: 祭司长和文士听见这话，就想法子要除灭耶稣，却又怕他，因为众人都希奇他的教训。
11.en: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

11.zh: 每天晚上，耶稣出城去。
11.en: When evening came, he went out of the city.

11.zh: 早晨，他们从那里经过，看见无花果树连根都枯干了。
11.en: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

11.zh: 彼得想起耶稣的话来，就对他说：「拉比，请看！你所咒诅的无花果树已经枯干了。」
11.en: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”

11.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们当信服　神。
11.en: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

11.zh: 我实在告诉你们，无论何人对这座山说：『你挪开此地，投在海里！』他若心里不疑惑，只信他所说的必成，就必给他成了。
11.en: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

11.zh: 所以我告诉你们，凡你们祷告祈求的，无论是什么，只要信是得着的，就必得着。
11.en: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

11.zh: 你们站着祷告的时候，若想起有人得罪你们，就当饶恕他，好叫你们在天上的父也饶恕你们的过犯。
11.en: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

11.zh: 你们若不饶恕人，你们在天上的父也不饶恕你们的过犯。」
11.en: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”

11.zh: 他们又来到耶路撒冷。耶稣在殿里行走的时候，祭司长和文士并长老进前来，
11.en: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

11.zh: 问他说：「你仗着什么权柄做这些事？给你这权柄的是谁呢？」
11.en: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

11.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「我要问你们一句话，你们回答我，我就告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。
11.en: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

11.zh: 约翰的洗礼是从天上来的？是从人间来的呢？你们可以回答我。」
11.en: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

11.zh: 他们彼此商议说：「我们若说『从天上来』，他必说：『这样，你们为什么不信他呢？』
11.en: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

11.zh: 若说『从人间来』，却又怕百姓，因为众人真以约翰为先知。」
11.en: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

11.zh: 于是回答耶稣说：「我们不知道。」耶稣说：「我也不告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。」
11.en: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

12.zh: 耶稣就用比喻对他们说：「有人栽了一个葡萄园，周围圈上篱笆，挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座楼，租给园户，就往外国去了。
12.en: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

12.zh: 到了时候，打发一个仆人到园户那里，要从园户收葡萄园的果子。
12.en: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

12.zh: 园户拿住他，打了他，叫他空手回去。
12.en: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

12.zh: 再打发一个仆人到他们那里。他们打伤他的头，并且凌辱他。
12.en: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

12.zh: 又打发一个仆人去，他们就杀了他。后又打发好些仆人去，有被他们打的，有被他们杀的。
12.en: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.

12.zh: 园主还有一位是他的爱子，末后又打发他去，[意思]说：『他们必尊敬我的儿子。』
12.en: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

12.zh: 不料，那些园户彼此说：『这是承受产业的。来吧，我们杀他，产业就归我们了！』
12.en: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

12.zh: 于是拿住他，杀了他，把他丢在园外。
12.en: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

12.zh: 这样，葡萄园的主人要怎么办呢？他要来除灭那些园户，将葡萄园转给别人。
12.en: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

12.zh: [经上写着说]： 匠人所弃的石头 已作了房角的头块石头。
12.en: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.

12.zh: 这是主所做的， 在我们眼中看为希奇。 这经你们没有念过吗？」
12.en: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”

12.zh: 他们看出这比喻是指着他们说的，就想要捉拿他，只是惧怕百姓，于是离开他走了。
12.en: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.

12.zh: 后来，他们打发几个法利赛人和几个希律党的人到耶稣那里，要就着他的话陷害他。
12.en: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

12.zh: 他们来了，就对他说：「夫子，我们知道你是诚实的，什么人你都不徇情面；因为你不看人的外貌，乃是诚诚实实传　神的道。纳税给凯撒可以不可以？
12.en: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

12.zh: 我们该纳不该纳？」耶稣知道他们的假意，就对他们说：「你们为什么试探我？拿一个银钱来给我看！」
12.en: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”

12.zh: 他们就拿了来。耶稣说：「这像和这号是谁的？」他们说：「是凯撒的。」
12.en: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

12.zh: 耶稣说：「凯撒的物当归给凯撒，　神的物当归给　神。」他们就很希奇他。
12.en: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.

12.zh: 撒都该人常说没有复活的事。他们来问耶稣说：
12.en: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

12.zh: 「夫子，摩西为我们写着说：『人若死了，撇下妻子，没有孩子，他兄弟当娶他的妻，为哥哥生子立后。』
12.en: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

12.zh: 有弟兄七人，第一个娶了妻，死了，没有留下孩子。
12.en: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

12.zh: 第二个娶了她，也死了，没有留下孩子。第三个也是这样。
12.en: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

12.zh: 那七个人都没有留下孩子；末了，那妇人也死了。
12.en: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

12.zh: 当复活的时候，她是哪一个的妻子呢？因为他们七个人都娶过她。」
12.en: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

12.zh: 耶稣说：「你们所以错了，岂不是因为不明白圣经，不晓得　神的大能吗？
12.en: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?

12.zh: 人从死里复活，也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一样。
12.en: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

12.zh: 论到死人复活，你们没有念过摩西的书荆棘篇上[所载的]吗？　神对摩西说：『我是亚伯拉罕的　神，以撒的　神，雅各的　神。』
12.en: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

12.zh: 神不是死人的　神，乃是活人的　神。你们是大错了。」
12.en: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

12.zh: 有一个文士来，听见他们辩论，晓得耶稣回答的好，就问他说：「诫命中哪是第一[要紧的]呢？」
12.en: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”

12.zh: 耶稣回答说：「第一[要紧的]就是说：『以色列啊，你要听，主—我们　神是独一的主。
12.en: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

12.zh: 你要尽心、尽性、尽意、尽力爱主—你的　神。』
12.en: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

12.zh: 其次就是说：『要爱人如己。』再没有比这两条诫命更大的了。」
12.en: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

12.zh: 那文士对耶稣说：「夫子说，　神是一位，实在不错；除了他以外，再没有别的　神；
12.en: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;

12.zh: 并且尽心、尽智、尽力爱他，又爱人如己，就比一切燔祭和各样祭祀好的多。」
12.en: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

12.zh: 耶稣见他回答的有智慧，就对他说：「你离　神的国不远了。」从此以后，没有人敢再问他什么。
12.en: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

12.zh: 耶稣在殿里教训人，就问他们说：「文士怎么说基督是大卫的子孙呢？
12.en: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

12.zh: 大卫被圣灵感动，说： 主对我主说： 你坐在我的右边， 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。
12.en: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

12.zh: 大卫既自己称他为主，他怎么又是大卫的子孙呢？」众人都喜欢听他。
12.en: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

12.zh: 耶稣在教训之间，说：「你们要防备文士；他们好穿长衣游行，喜爱人在街市上问他们的安，
12.en: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

12.zh: 又喜爱会堂里的高位，筵席上的首座。
12.en: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,

12.zh: 他们侵吞寡妇的家产，假意作很长的祷告。这些人要受更重的刑罚！」
12.en: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

12.zh: 耶稣对银库坐着，看众人怎样投钱入库。有好些财主往里投了若干的钱。
12.en: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

12.zh: 有一个穷寡妇来，往里投了两个小钱，就是一个大钱。
12.en: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

12.zh: 耶稣叫门徒来，说：「我实在告诉你们，这穷寡妇投入库里的，比众人所投的更多。
12.en: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

12.zh: 因为，他们都是自己有余，拿出来投在里头；但这寡妇是自己不足，把她一切养生的都投上了。」
12.en: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”

13.zh: 耶稣从殿里出来的时候，有一个门徒对他说：「夫子，请看，这是何等的石头！何等的殿宇！」
13.en: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”

13.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你看见这大殿宇吗？将来在这里没有一块石头留在石头上，不被拆毁了。」
13.en: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”

13.zh: 耶稣在橄榄山上对[圣]殿而坐。彼得、雅各、约翰，和安得烈暗暗地问他说：
13.en: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

13.zh: 「请告诉我们，什么时候有这些事呢？这一切事将成的时候有什么预兆呢？」
13.en: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

13.zh: 耶稣说：「你们要谨慎，免得有人迷惑你们。
13.en: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

13.zh: 将来有好些人冒我的名来，说：『我是[基督]』，并且要迷惑许多人。
