13.en: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.

13.zh: 你们听见打仗和打仗的风声，不要惊慌。[这些事]是必须有的，只是末期还没有到。
13.en: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

13.zh: 民要攻打民，国要攻打国；多处必有地震、饥荒。这都是灾难的起头。
13.en: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

13.zh: 但你们要谨慎；因为人要把你们交给公会，并且你们在会堂里要受鞭打，又为我的缘故站在诸侯与君王面前，对他们作见证。
13.en: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

13.zh: 然而，福音必须先传给万民。
13.en: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

13.zh: 人把你们拉去交官的时候，不要预先思虑说什么；到那时候，赐给你们什么话，你们就说什么；因为说话的不是你们，乃是圣灵。
13.en: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

13.zh: 弟兄要把弟兄，父亲要把儿子，送到死地；儿女要起来与父母为敌，害死他们；
13.en: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

13.zh: 并且你们要为我的名被众人恨恶。惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。」
13.en: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

13.zh: 「你们看见那行毁坏可憎的，站在不当站的地方（读[这经]的人须要会意）。那时，在犹太的，应当逃到山上；
13.en: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

13.zh: 在房上的，不要下来，也不要进去拿家里的东西；
13.en: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

13.zh: 在田里的，也不要回去取衣裳。
13.en: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

13.zh: 当那些日子，怀孕的和奶孩子的有祸了！
13.en: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

13.zh: 你们应当祈求，叫这些事不在冬天临到。
13.en: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.

13.zh: 因为在那些日子必有灾难，自从　神创造万物直到如今，并没有这样的灾难，后来也必没有。
13.en: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

13.zh: 若不是主减少那日子，凡有血气的，总没有一个得救的；只是为主的选民，他将那日子减少了。
13.en: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

13.zh: 那时若有人对你们说：『看哪，基督在这里』，或说：『基督在那里』，你们不要信！
13.en: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

13.zh: 因为假基督、假先知将要起来，显神迹奇事，倘若能行，就把选民迷惑了。
13.en: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

13.zh: 你们要谨慎。看哪，凡事我都预先告诉你们了。」
13.en: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

13.zh: 「在那些日子，那灾难以后， 日头要变黑了， 月亮也不放光，
13.en: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

13.zh: 众星要从天上坠落， 天势都要震动。
13.en: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

13.zh: 那时，他们要看见人子有大能力、大荣耀，驾云降临。
13.en: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

13.zh: 他要差遣天使，把他的选民，从四方，从地极直到天边，都招聚了来。」
13.en: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

13.zh: 「你们可以从无花果树学个比方：当树枝发嫩长叶的时候，你们就知道夏天近了。
13.en: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

13.zh: 这样，你们几时看见这些事成就，也该知道人子近了，正在门口了。
13.en: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

13.zh: 我实在告诉你们，这世代还没有过去，这些事都要成就。
13.en: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

13.zh: 天地要废去，我的话却不能废去。」
13.en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

13.zh: 「但那日子，那时辰，没有人知道，连天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟有父知道。
13.en: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

13.zh: 你们要谨慎，警醒祈祷，因为你们不晓得那日期几时来到。
13.en: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.

13.zh: 这事正如一个人离开本家，寄居外邦，把权柄交给仆人，分派各人当做的工，又吩咐看门的警醒。
13.en: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

13.zh: 所以，你们要警醒；因为你们不知道家主什么时候来，或晚上，或半夜，或鸡叫，或早晨；
13.en: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

13.zh: 恐怕他忽然来到，看见你们睡着了。
13.en: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.

13.zh: 我对你们所说的话，也是对众人说：要警醒！」
13.en: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”

14.zh: 过两天是逾越[节]，又是除酵节，祭司长和文士想法子怎么用诡计捉拿耶稣，杀他。
14.en: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.

14.zh: 只是说：「当节的日子不可，恐怕百姓生乱。」
14.en: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”

14.zh: 耶稣在伯大尼长大麻风的西门家里坐席的时候，有一个女人拿着一玉瓶至贵的真哪哒香膏来，打破玉瓶，把膏浇在耶稣的头上。
14.en: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.

14.zh: 有几个人心中很不喜悦，说：「何用这样枉费香膏呢？
14.en: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?

14.zh: 这香膏可以卖三十多两银子周济穷人。」他们就向那女人生气。
14.en: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.

14.zh: 耶稣说：「由她吧！为什么难为她呢？她在我身上做的是一件美事。
14.en: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

14.zh: 因为常有穷人和你们同在，要向他们行善随时都可以；只是你们不常有我。
14.en: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

14.zh: 她所做的，是尽她所能的；她是为我安葬的事把香膏预先浇在我身上。
14.en: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

14.zh: 我实在告诉你们，普天之下，无论在什么地方传这福音，也要述说这女人所做的，以为记念。」
14.en: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”

14.zh: 十二门徒之中，有一个加略人犹大去见祭司长，要把耶稣交给他们。
14.en: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

14.zh: 他们听见就欢喜，又应许给他银子；他就寻思如何得便把耶稣交给他们。
14.en: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

14.zh: 除酵节的第一天，就是宰逾越[羊羔]的那一天，门徒对耶稣说：「你吃逾越[节的筵席]要我们往哪里去预备呢？」
14.en: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

14.zh: 耶稣就打发两个门徒，对他们说：「你们进城去，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而来，你们就跟着他。
14.en: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,

14.zh: 他进哪家去，你们就对那家的主人说：『夫子说：客房在哪里？我与门徒好在那里吃逾越[节的筵席]。』
14.en: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

14.zh: 他必指给你们摆设整齐的一间大楼，你们就在那里为我们预备。」
14.en: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

14.zh: 门徒出去，进了城，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的。他们就预备了逾越[节的筵席]。
14.en: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

14.zh: 到了晚上，耶稣和十二个门徒都来了。
14.en: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

14.zh: 他们坐席正吃的时候，耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，你们中间有一个与我同吃的人要卖我了。」
14.en: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”

14.zh: 他们就忧愁起来，一个一个地问他说：「是我吗？」
14.en: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

14.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「是十二个门徒中同我蘸手在盘子里的那个人。
14.en: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

14.zh: 人子必要去世，正如[经上]指着他所写的；但卖人子的人有祸了！那人不生在世上倒好。」
14.en: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

14.zh: 他们吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝了福，就擘开，递给他们，说：「你们拿着吃，这是我的身体」；
14.en: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”

14.zh: 又拿起杯来，祝谢了，递给他们；他们都喝了。
14.en: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

14.zh: 耶稣说：「这是我立约的血，为多人流出来的。
14.en: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

14.zh: 我实在告诉你们，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直到我在　神的国里喝新的那日子。」
14.en: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”

14.zh: 他们唱了诗，就出来，往橄榄山去。
14.en: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

14.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们都要跌倒了，因为[经上]记着说： 我要击打牧人， 羊就分散了。
14.en: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

14.zh: 但我复活以后，要在你们以先往加利利去。」
14.en: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

14.zh: 彼得说：「众人虽然跌倒，我总不能。」
14.en: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”

14.zh: 耶稣对他说：「我实在告诉你，就在今天夜里，鸡叫两遍以先，你要三次不认我。」
14.en: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

14.zh: 彼得却极力地说：「我就是必须和你同死，也总不能不认你。」众门徒都是这样说。
14.en: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

14.zh: 他们来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼。耶稣对门徒说：「你们坐在这里，等我祷告。」
14.en: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

14.zh: 于是带着彼得、雅各、约翰同去，就惊恐起来，极其难过，
14.en: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

14.zh: 对他们说：「我心里甚是忧伤，几乎要死；你们在这里等候，警醒。」
14.en: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”

14.zh: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，祷告说：「倘若可行，便叫那时候过去。」
14.en: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

14.zh: 他说：「阿爸！父啊！在你凡事都能；求你将这杯撤去。然而，不要从我的意思，只要从你的意思。」
14.en: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

14.zh: 耶稣回来，见他们睡着了，就对彼得说：「西门，你睡觉吗？不能警醒片时吗？
14.en: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?

14.zh: 总要警醒祷告，免得入了迷惑。你们心灵固然愿意，肉体却软弱了。」
14.en: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

14.zh: 耶稣又去祷告，说的话还是与先前一样，
14.en: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.

14.zh: 又来见他们睡着了，因为他们的眼睛甚是困倦；他们也不知道怎么回答。
14.en: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.

14.zh: 第三次来，对他们说：「现在你们仍然睡觉安歇吧！够了，时候到了。看哪，人子被卖在罪人手里了。
14.en: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

14.zh: 起来！我们走吧。看哪，那卖我的人近了！」
14.en: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

14.zh: 说话之间，忽然那十二个门徒里的犹大来了，并有许多人带着刀棒，从祭司长和文士并长老那里与他同来。
14.en: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

14.zh: 卖耶稣的人曾给他们一个暗号，说：「我与谁亲嘴，谁就是他。你们把他拿住，牢牢靠靠地带去。」
14.en: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”

14.zh: 犹大来了，随即到耶稣跟前，说：「拉比」，便与他亲嘴。
14.en: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.

14.zh: 他们就下手拿住他。
14.en: They laid their hands on him and seized him.

14.zh: 旁边站着的人，有一个拔出刀来，将大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他一个耳朵。
14.en: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

14.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们带着刀棒出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？
14.en: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

14.zh: 我天天教训人，同你们在殿里，你们并没有拿我。但[这事成就]，为要应验经上的话。」
14.en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

14.zh: 门徒都离开他，逃走了。
14.en: They all left him, and fled.

14.zh: 有一个少年人，赤身披着一块麻布，跟随耶稣，众人就捉拿他。
14.en: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

14.zh: 他却丢了麻布，赤身逃走了。
14.en: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

14.zh: 他们把耶稣带到大祭司那里，又有众祭司长和长老并文士都来和大祭司一同聚集。
14.en: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

14.zh: 彼得远远地跟着耶稣，一直进入大祭司的院里，和差役一同坐在火光里烤火。
14.en: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

14.zh: 祭司长和全公会寻找见证控告耶稣，要治死他，却寻不着。
14.en: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

14.zh: 因为有好些人作假见证告他，只是他们的见证各不相合。
14.en: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

14.zh: 又有几个人站起来作假见证告他，说：
14.en: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,

14.zh: 「我们听见他说：『我要拆毁这人手所造的殿，三日内就另造一座不是人手所造的。』」
14.en: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

14.zh: 他们就是这么作见证，也是各不相合。
14.en: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.

14.zh: 大祭司起来站在中间，问耶稣说：「你什么都不回答吗？这些人作见证告你的是什么呢？」
14.en: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

14.zh: 耶稣却不言语，一句也不回答。大祭司又问他说：「你是那当称颂者的儿子基督不是？」
14.en: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”

14.zh: 耶稣说：「我是。你们必看见人子坐在那权能者的右边，驾着天上的云降临。」
14.en: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

14.zh: 大祭司就撕开衣服，说：「我们何必再用见证人呢？
14.en: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

14.zh: 你们已经听见他这僭妄的话了。你们的意见如何？」他们都定他该死的罪。
14.en: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

14.zh: 就有人吐唾沫在他脸上，又蒙着他的脸，用拳头打他，对他说：「你说预言吧！」差役接过他来，用手掌打他。
14.en: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

14.zh: 彼得在下边院子里；来了大祭司的一个使女，
14.en: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

14.zh: 见彼得烤火，就看着他，说：「你素来也是同拿撒勒人耶稣一伙的。」
14.en: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

14.zh: 彼得却不承认，说：「我不知道，也不明白你说的是什么。」于是出来，到了前院，鸡就叫了。
14.en: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

14.zh: 那使女看见他，又对旁边站着的人说：「这也是他们一党的。」
14.en: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

14.zh: 彼得又不承认。过了不多的时候，旁边站着的人又对彼得说：「你真是他们一党的！因为你是加利利人。」
14.en: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

14.zh: 彼得就发咒起誓地说：「我不认得你们说的这个人。」
14.en: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

14.zh: 立时鸡叫了第二遍。彼得想起耶稣对他所说的话：「鸡叫两遍以先，你要三次不认我。」思想起来，就哭了。
14.en: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.

15.zh: 一到早晨，祭司长和长老、文士、全公会的人大家商议，就把耶稣捆绑，解去交给彼拉多。
15.en: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

15.zh: 彼拉多问他说：「你是犹太人的王吗？」耶稣回答说：「你说的是。」
15.en: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”

15.zh: 祭司长告他许多的事。
15.en: The chief priests accused him of many things.

15.zh: 彼拉多又问他说：「你看，他们告你这么多的事，你什么都不回答吗？」
15.en: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

15.zh: 耶稣仍不回答，以致彼拉多觉得希奇。
15.en: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

15.zh: 每逢这节期，巡抚照众人所求的，释放一个囚犯给他们。
15.en: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

15.zh: 有一个人名叫巴拉巴，和作乱的人一同捆绑。他们作乱的时候，曾杀过人。
15.en: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

15.zh: 众人上去求巡抚，照常例给他们办。
15.en: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

15.zh: 彼拉多说：「你们要我释放犹太人的王给你们吗？」
15.en: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

15.zh: 他原晓得，祭司长是因为嫉妒才把耶稣解了来。
15.en: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

15.zh: 只是祭司长挑唆众人，宁可释放巴拉巴给他们。
15.en: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

15.zh: 彼拉多又说：「那么样，你们所称为犹太人的王，我怎么办他呢？」
15.en: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

15.zh: 他们又喊着说：「把他钉十字架！」
15.en: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

15.zh: 彼拉多说：「为什么呢？他做了什么恶事呢？」他们便极力地喊着说：「把他钉十字架！」
15.en: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

15.zh: 彼拉多要叫众人喜悦，就释放巴拉巴给他们，将耶稣鞭打了，交给人钉十字架。
15.en: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

15.zh: 兵丁把耶稣带进衙门院里，叫齐了全营的兵。
15.en: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

15.zh: 他们给他穿上紫袍，又用荆棘编做冠冕给他戴上，
15.en: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

15.zh: 就庆贺他说：「恭喜，犹太人的王啊！」
15.en: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

15.zh: 又拿一根苇子打他的头，吐唾沫在他脸上，屈膝拜他。
15.en: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

15.zh: 戏弄完了，就给他脱了紫袍，仍穿上他自己的衣服，带他出去，要钉十字架。
15.en: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

15.zh: 有一个古利奈人西门，就是亚历山大和鲁孚的父亲，从乡下来，经过那地方，他们就勉强他同去，好背着耶稣的十字架。
15.en: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

15.zh: 他们带耶稣到了各各他地方（各各他翻出来就是髑髅地），
15.en: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

15.zh: 拿没药调和的酒给耶稣，他却不受。
15.en: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

15.zh: 于是将他钉在十字架上，拈阄分他的衣服，看是谁得什么。
15.en: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

15.zh: 钉他在十字架上是巳初的时候。
15.en: It was the third hour when they crucified him.

15.zh: 在上面有他的罪状，写的是：「犹太人的王。」
15.en: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

15.zh: 他们又把两个强盗和他同钉十字架，一个在右边，一个在左边。
15.en: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.
The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”

15.zh: 从那里经过的人辱骂他，摇着头说：「咳！你这拆毁圣殿、三日又建造起来的，
15.en: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,

15.zh: 可以救自己，从十字架上下来吧！」
15.en: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

15.zh: 祭司长和文士也是这样戏弄他，彼此说：「他救了别人，不能救自己。
15.en: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

15.zh: 以色列的王基督，现在可以从十字架上下来，叫我们看见，就信了。」那和他同钉的人也是讥诮他。
15.en: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

15.zh: 从午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。
15.en: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

15.zh: 申初的时候，耶稣大声喊着说：「以罗伊！以罗伊！拉马撒巴各大尼？」（翻出来就是：我的　神！我的　神！为什么离弃我？）
15.en: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

15.zh: 旁边站着的人，有的听见就说：「看哪，他叫以利亚呢！」
15.en: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

15.zh: 有一个人跑去，把海绒蘸满了醋，绑在苇子上，送给他喝，说：「且等着，看以利亚来不来把他取下。」
15.en: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”

15.zh: 耶稣大声喊叫，气就断了。
15.en: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

15.zh: 殿里的幔子从上到下裂为两半。
15.en: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

15.zh: 对面站着的百夫长看见耶稣这样喊叫断气，就说：「这人真是　神的儿子！」
15.en: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

15.zh: 还有些妇女远远地观看；内中有抹大拉的马利亚，又有小雅各和约西的母亲马利亚，并有撒罗米，
15.en: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

15.zh: 就是耶稣在 加利利的时候，跟随他、服事他的那些人，还有同耶稣上耶路撒冷的好些妇女 [在那里观看]。
15.en: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

15.zh: 到了晚上，因为这是预备日，就是安息日的前一日，
15.en: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

15.zh: 有亚利马太的约瑟前来，他是尊贵的议士，也是等候　神国的。他放胆进去见彼拉多，求耶稣的身体；
15.en: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

15.zh: 彼拉多诧异耶稣已经死了，便叫百夫长来，问他耶稣死了久不久。
15.en: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

15.zh: 既从百夫长得知实情，就把耶稣的尸首赐给约瑟。
15.en: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

15.zh: 约瑟买了细麻布，把耶稣取下来，用细麻布裹好，安放在磐石中凿出来的坟墓里，又滚过一块石头来挡住墓门。
15.en: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

15.zh: 抹大拉的马利亚和约西的母亲马利亚都看见安放他的地方。
15.en: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

16.zh: 过了安息日，抹大拉的马利亚和雅各的母亲马利亚并撒罗米，买了香膏要去膏耶稣的身体。
16.en: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

16.zh: 七日的第一日清早，出太阳的时候，她们来到坟墓那里，
16.en: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

16.zh: 彼此说：「谁给我们把石头从墓门滚开呢？」
16.en: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

16.zh: 那石头原来很大，她们抬头一看，却见石头已经滚开了。
16.en: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

16.zh: 她们进了坟墓，看见一个少年人坐在右边，穿着白袍，就甚惊恐。
16.en: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

16.zh: 那少年人对她们说：「不要惊恐！你们寻找那钉十字架的拿撒勒人耶稣，他已经复活了，不在这里。请看安放他的地方。
16.en: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

16.zh: 你们可以去告诉他的门徒和彼得，说：『他在你们以先往加利利去。在那里你们要见他，正如他从前所告诉你们的。』」
16.en: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

16.zh: 她们就出来，从坟墓那里逃跑，又发抖又惊奇，什么也不告诉人，因为她们害怕。
16.en: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

16.zh: 在七日的第一日清早，耶稣复活了，就先向抹大拉的马利亚显现（耶稣从她身上曾赶出七个鬼）。
16.en: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

16.zh: 她去告诉那向来跟随耶稣的人；那时他们正哀恸哭泣。
16.en: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

16.zh: 他们听见耶稣活了，被马利亚看见，却是不信。
16.en: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

16.zh: 这事以后，门徒中间有两个人往乡下去。走路的时候，耶稣变了形象，向他们显现。
16.en: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

16.zh: 他们就去告诉其余的门徒；其余的门徒也是不信。
16.en: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

16.zh: 后来，十一个门徒坐席的时候，耶稣向他们显现，责备他们不信，心里刚硬，因为他们不信那些在他复活以后看见他的人。
16.en: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

16.zh: 他又对他们说：「你们往普天下去，传福音给万民听。
16.en: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

16.zh: 信而受洗的，必然得救；不信的，必被定罪。
16.en: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

16.zh: 信的人必有神迹随着他们，就是奉我的名赶鬼；说新方言；
16.en: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

16.zh: 手能拿蛇；若喝了什么毒物，也必不受害；手按病人，病人就必好了。」
16.en: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

16.zh: 主耶稣和他们说完了话，后来被接到天上，坐在　神的右边。
16.en: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

16.zh: 门徒出去，到处宣传[福音]。主和他们同工，用神迹随着，证实所传的道。阿们！
16.en: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
